answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity at the root: each agent posts a slashable bond recorded in one shared registry kernel, and every additional identity funded from the same origin costs quadratically more collateral. A ferrous, tamper-evident link ties each bond to its funding source, so a sybil swarm must lock N-squared capital to run N fakes and forfeits all of it on detected collusion. An honest single agent stays as cheap as one lotus; an attacker pays ruinously to scale.
